candidate: Skip SplitFuse and use existing legacy PFA TND for current FP16 B8

findings.details: PFA TND host path generates a complete MLAGeneralTilingData, M=min(512,alignedS1), S2base=min(128,alignedS2), nRatio=min(4,s2Outer), causal sparse3, workspace, core mapping and key.

TND VarLen key declarations and implementations are in DT_BF16 query/key/output conditional block and instantiate bfloat16_t,float. Current DT_FLOAT16 branch contains no corresponding TND VarLen key. Macro names QFP16 do not establish FP16 support. Host only skip can therefore not establish valid kernel computation for the current input dtype.

Actual SplitFuse uses FP16 Q/K/V/P/O and FP32 S/OTmp/Update/LSE. Existing PFA TND instance uses BF16 INPUT_T and float intermediate T, including float->INPUT_T stage1 cast. Changing model/input dtype to reach PFA violates the fixed FP16 experiment. A new half,float instantiation could only be a new unvalidated kernel candidate, not reuse of an existing supported FP16 path.
